objective.statement: Feel a steady beat and compare crotchets, minims and semibreves by how many beats they last.
successCriteria: I can feel and tap a steady beat.
I know a crotchet lasts 1 beat, a minim 2 and a semibreve 4.
I can add up how many beats some notes last altogether.

explanation.text: Most music has a steady pulse, like a ticking clock or a heartbeat. Each tick is a beat. Try tapping your foot along to a song you know.
Notes tell us how many beats a sound lasts. The crotchet is our unit: one crotchet lasts one beat. It has a solid black head and a stem.

music.textAlternative: A crotchet, a minim and a semibreve in a row, labelled with the number of beats each lasts: 1, 2 and 4.

explanation.caption: Crotchet: 1 beat. Minim: 2 beats. Semibreve: 4 beats.

explanation.text: A minim has a hollow head and a stem, and lasts as long as two crotchets. A semibreve is hollow with no stem and lasts as long as four crotchets: the longest note you will meet in Grade 1.

Say the counts out loud. A crotchet is 'one'. A minim holds for 'one, two'. A semibreve holds for 'one, two, three, four'. In some countries these notes are called quarter note, half note and whole note; both sets of names mean the same.

music.textAlternative: Three bars of four beats each: four crotchets, then two minims, then one semibreve.
music.questionAlternative: Bar 1: crotchet, crotchet, crotchet, crotchet. Bar 2: minim, minim. Bar 3: semibreve.

steps: Press Play all and tap the beat on your lap. Each crotchet is one tap.
In the second bar each minim lasts for two taps: hold the sound across both.
In the last bar the semibreve lasts for four taps. Count 'one, two, three, four' while it plays.
All three bars are the same length. Four crotchets, two minims and one semibreve each fill four beats.
demonstration.textAlternative: Three bars that each last four beats: four crotchets, two minims, and a single semibreve. Playing them shows that longer notes last for more taps of the beat.

guided.prompt: How many crotchet beats does this minim last?

1.reason: A minim lasts 2 crotchet beats, not 1. A semibreve is 4 beats, a minim 2 and a crotchet 1. One beat is a crotchet; a minim is twice as long.

3.reason: A minim lasts 2 crotchet beats, not 3. A semibreve is 4 beats, a minim 2 and a crotchet 1.

4.reason: A minim lasts 2 crotchet beats, not 4. A semibreve is 4 beats, a minim 2 and a crotchet 1.

hints: Count everything in crotchet beats.
A semibreve lasts four crotchet beats.
A semibreve lasts 4 crotchet beats, a minim 2, a crotchet 1. A dot adds half again.

feedback.correct: Yes: a minim lasts 2 crotchet beats.

mistakes.halved-or-doubled: That value is twice (or half) as long. Count it in crotchet beats and compare.
mistakes.dot-misread: Remember: a dot adds half of the note's own value. Work out that half, then add it.
mistakes.note-rest-confusion: Check the shape carefully. A rest that hangs below its line lasts longer than one that sits on top of it.
mistakes.tie-dot-confusion: A tie joins two notes into one sound, so add both values together.
mistakes.tuplet-ignored: Those notes are a tuplet, so they share a different amount of time. Look at the number written over them.

feedback.fallback: Not quite. Try counting each value in crotchet beats.
